name: Top10
description: Represents a top ten visual of a conditional formatting rule. Applying a color to a range helps you see the value of a cell relative to other cells.
remarks: All conditional formatting objects are contained within a FormatConditions collection object, which is a child of a Range collection. You can create a top 10 formatting rule by using either the Add or AddTop10 method of the FormatConditions collection.
example:
Sub Top10CF()

' Building data
 Range("A1").Value = "Name"
 Range("B1").Value = "Number"
 Range("A2").Value = "Agent1"
 Range("A2").AutoFill Destination:=Range("A2:A26"), Type:=xlFillDefault
 Range("B2:B26").FormulaArray = "=INT(RAND()*101)"
 Range("B2:B26").Select

' Applying Conditional Formatting Top 10
 Selection.FormatConditions.AddTop10
 Selection.FormatConditions(Selection.FormatConditions.Count).SetFirstPriority
 With Selection.FormatConditions(1)
 .TopBottom = xlTop10Top
 .Rank = 10
 .Percent = False
 End With

' Applying color fill
 With Selection.FormatConditions(1).Font
 .Color = -16752384
 .TintAndShade = 0
 End With
 With Selection.FormatConditions(1).Interior
 .PatternColorIndex = xlAutomatic
 .Color = 13561798
 .TintAndShade = 0
 End With
MsgBox "Added Top10 Conditional Format. Press F9 to update values.", vbInformation

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Priority
properties.description: Returns or sets the priority value of the conditional formatting rule. The priority determines the order of evaluation when multiple conditional formatting rules exist on a worksheet.

properties.name: StopIfTrue
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that determines if additional formatting rules on the cell should be evaluated if the current rule evaluates to True.

properties.name: AppliesTo
properties.description: Returns a Range object specifying the cell range to which the formatting rule is applied.

properties.name: TopBottom
properties.description: Returns or sets one of the constants of the XlTopBottom enumeration, which determines if the ranking is evaluated from the top or bottom.

properties.name: Rank
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long value, specifying either the number or percentage of the rank value for the conditional formatting rule.

properties.name: Percent
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value, specifying if the rank is determined by a percentage value.

properties.name: Interior
properties.description: Returns an Interior object that specifies a cell's interior attributes for a conditional formatting rule that evaluates to True. Read-only.

properties.name: Borders
properties.description: Returns a Borders collection that specifies the formatting of cell borders if the conditional formatting rule evaluates to True. Read-only.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns a Font object that specifies the font formatting if the conditional formatting rule evaluates to True. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns one of the constants of the XlFormatConditionType enumeration, which specifies the type of conditional format. Read-only.

properties.name: NumberFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets the number format applied to a cell if the conditional formatting rule evaluates to True. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: PTCondition
properties.description: Returns a Boolean value indicating if the conditional format is being applied to a PivotTable. Read-only.

properties.name: ScopeType
properties.description: Returns or sets one of the constants of the XlPivotConditionScope enumeration, which determines the scope of the conditional format when it is applied to a PivotTable.

properties.name: CalcFor
properties.description: Returns or sets one of the constants of the XlCalcFor enumeration, which specifies how the conditional format in a PivotTable report should be evaluated.

methods.name: SetFirstPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority value for this conditional formatting rule to 1 so that it will be evaluated before all other rules on the worksheet.

methods.name: SetLastPriority
methods.description: Sets the evaluation order for this conditional formatting rule so that it is evaluated after all other rules on the worksheet.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified conditional formatting rule object.

methods.name: ModifyAppliesToRange
methods.description: Sets the cell range to which this formatting rule applies.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range to which this formatting rule will be applied.
